item.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
item.description: Yes Bank has filed a petition with the Supreme Court to review an order from October 15. This order upheld a Bombay High Court ruling that quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds. These bonds, worth Rs 8,415 crore, were questioned during Yes Bank's financial difficulties. The high court ruled that the bank's administrator lacked authority for such a write-off.

item.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
item.description: RHI Magnesita has reported a remarkable surge in net profit, soaring to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The consolidated revenues experienced a modest increase, hitting Rs 1,038.26 crore this period. Additionally, overall expenses decreased to Rs 953.06 crore compared to the last year. EBITDA saw a 30 percent growth, reflecting operational enhancements despite challenging economic conditions.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd has filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering with regulatory bodies. This IPO features an offer for sale of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares from Coal India, amounting to a 10 percent stake in the subsidiary MCL. The intended capital raise is around Rs 9,500 crore, with the final execution reliant on regulatory approval and market conditions.

item.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
item.description: The Nifty's current technical structure remains positive. Although a sharp rebound from the vicinity of the 200-week moving average has significantly improved the near-term technical setup, the Index is near its overhead resistance area.

item.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
item.description: Of these, we shortlisted 8 stocks that consistently gained throughout the period, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 7% to 11%.

item.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
item.description: Binance is set to restore withdrawals across all networks and assets by the end of next week. This decision comes after recovering 95% of the $6.3 billion lost in the October hack, which the FBI attributes to North Korean actors, though the nation denies any involvement. Binance pledges to fully reimburse affected clients as operations return to normal.
